cards.ex: Legalizing assisted suicide could be a slippery slope, leading to involuntary euthanasia.
cards.exUz: O'z joniga qasd qilishni qonuniylashtirish sirpanchiq yo'l bo'lishi mumkin va majburiy evtanaziyaga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Boshlanishi yaxshi, lekin oqibati yomon bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan vaziyat.

cards.ex: Saying that God exists because the Bible says so begs the question of the Bible's authority.
cards.exUz: Bibliyada aytilgani uchun Xudo bor deyish, Bibliyaning obro'si masalasini ko'taradi.
cards.uzDef: Dalil sifatida foydalanilayotgan narsa, aslida isbotlanishi kerak bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: The government's aid package is a drop in the bucket compared to the scale of the crisis.
cards.exUz: Hukumatning yordam paketi inqiroz ko'lamiga nisbatan tomchidan dengiz.
cards.uzDef: Juda kichik miqdor, katta muammoni hal qilish uchun yetarli emas.

cards.ex: The constant stress of living in poverty is bound to take its toll on their health.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlikda yashashning doimiy stressi ularning sog'lig'iga zarar yetkazishi aniq.
cards.uzDef: Vaqt o'tishi bilan salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatmoq, zarar yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: Reforming the healthcare system is difficult because of entrenched interests.
cards.exUz: Sog'liqni saqlash tizimini isloh qilish mustahkam manfaatlar tufayli qiyin.
cards.uzDef: O'z mavqeini saqlab qolishga harakat qiladigan kuchli guruhlar.

cards.ex: The rise of social media is changing the social fabric of our society.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tarmoqlarning o'sishi jamiyatimizning ijtimoiy to'qimasini o'zgartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning tuzilishi, odamlar o'rtasidagi munosabatlar.

cards.ex: Starting a business can be difficult because of all the red tape involved.
cards.exUz: Biznesni boshlash ko'plab byurokratik to'siqlar tufayli qiyin bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Keraksiz qoidalar va rasmiyatchiliklar, ishni qiyinlashtiruvchi narsalar.

cards.ex: The recent scandal was a wake-up call for the entire organization.
cards.exUz: Yaqinda bo'lgan janjal butun tashkilot uchun ogohlik qo'ng'irog'i bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: E'tiborni jalb qiladigan, xavf haqida ogohlantiruvchi voqea.

cards.ex: His actions fly in the face of everything he claims to believe in.
cards.exUz: Uning harakatlari u ishonaman degan barcha narsalarga zid.
cards.uzDef: Qabul qilingan fikrlar yoki qoidalarga zid bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Overcoming deep-seated prejudice requires education and understanding.
cards.exUz: Chuqur ildiz otgan xurofotni yengish ta'lim va tushunishni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Uzoq vaqt davomida shakllangan, qiyin o'zgartiriladigan xurofot.

cards.ex: Many promising initiatives fall by the wayside due to lack of funding.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab umidli tashabbuslar mablag' yetishmasligi tufayli chekkada qoladi.
cards.uzDef: E'tibordan chetda qolmoq, e'tiborsiz qoldirilmoq.

cards.ex: His promises of change ring hollow after years of inaction.
cards.exUz: Uning o'zgarish haqidagi va'dalari yillar davomidagi harakatsizlikdan keyin quruq gapdek tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz, samimiy bo'lmagan, bo'shdek tuyulmoq.

cards.ex: High levels of social stratification can lead to social unrest.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tabaqalanishning yuqori darajasi ijtimoiy tartibsizliklarga olib kelishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning turli tabaqalarga bo'linishi (masalan, boy va kambag'al).

cards.ex: When the scandal broke, the party decided to close ranks and support their leader.
cards.exUz: Janjal chiqqanda, partiya birlashishga va o'z liderini qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatda birgalikda harakat qilish, yordam berish.

cards.ex: The media often perpetuates the myth that success is only about hard work.
cards.exUz: Ommaviy axborot vositalari ko'pincha muvaffaqiyat faqat qattiq mehnat bilan bog'liq degan afsonani davom ettiradi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri fikrni tarqatish, uni haqiqatdek ko'rsatish.

cards.ex: Many families are living on the breadline due to the rising cost of living.
cards.exUz: Ko'plab oilalar hayotning qimmatlashishi tufayli ochlik yoqasida yashamoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda kambag'al, eng zarur narsalarni ham sotib ololmaydigan odam.

cards.ex: The election of the first female president was a watershed moment in the country's history.
cards.exUz: Birinchi ayol prezidentning saylanishi mamlakat tarixidagi burilish nuqtasi bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim o'zgarishlarga olib keladigan voqea yoki vaqt.

cards.ex: We need to ensure a level playing field for all students, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha talabalar uchun, kelib chiqishidan qat'i nazar, teng imkoniyatlarni ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Hamma uchun teng va adolatli sharoit.

cards.ex: His divisive rhetoric is sowing the seeds of conflict in the community.
cards.exUz: Uning bo'linishga qaratilgan ritorikasi jamiyatda mojaro urug'ini sepmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Keltirib chiqarmoq, sabab bo'lmoq (odatda salbiy narsa).

cards.ex: Many social problems stem from a lack of education and opportunity.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina ijtimoiy muammolar ta'lim va imkoniyatlarning yetishmasligidan kelib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadandir paydo bo'lmoq, sababi nimadir bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The report highlighted the problem of institutional bias within the police force.
cards.exUz: Hisobot politsiya kuchlari ichidagi tashkiliy tarafkashlik muammosini yoritdi.
cards.uzDef: Tashkilotning siyosati va amaliyotida mavjud bo'lgan tarafkashlik.

cards.ex: Instead of admitting their mistake, the government decided to double down on its policies.
cards.exUz: Hukumat xatosini tan olish o'rniga, o'z siyosatini ikki hissa kuchaytirishga qaror qildi.
cards.uzDef: Oldingi xatoni tan olmasdan, xuddi shu harakatni davom ettirmoq.

cards.ex: We need policies that create a level playing field for all citizens.
cards.exUz: Biz barcha fuqarolar uchun teng sharoit yaratadigan siyosatlarga muhtojmiz.
cards.uzDef: Adolatli va teng imkoniyatlar.

cards.ex: He knew he had to face the music for his actions.
cards.exUz: U o'z harakatlari uchun javobgarlikka tortilishi kerakligini bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Xato uchun javobgarlikka tortilmoq, oqibatlarini qabul qilmoq.

cards.ex: The gap between the haves and have-nots is widening.
cards.exUz: Boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi tafovut kengaymoqda.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatning boy va kambag'al qatlamlari.

cards.ex: Many vulnerable people are falling through the cracks in the system.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina zaif odamlar tizimdagi yoriqlar orqali e'tibordan chetda qolmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj bo'lgan, lekin hech kimga kerak bo'lmagan odamlar.

cards.ex: Some people consider taxes a necessary evil.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar soliqlarni zarur yomonlik deb hisoblashadi.
cards.uzDef: Yoqimsiz yoki zararli, lekin zarur bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: Poverty can be a breeding ground for crime.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik jinoyatchilik uchun yetishtirish joyi bo'lishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir ko'payadigan yoki rivojlanadigan joy.

cards.ex: The government is trying to stem the tide of illegal immigration.
cards.exUz: Hukumat noqonuniy immigratsiya oqimini to'xtatishga harakat qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Nimaningdir yomonlashishini to'xtatishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: Without intervention, these communities could enter a downward spiral of poverty and crime.
cards.exUz: Arlashuvsiz, bu jamiyatlar qashshoqlik va jinoyatchilikning pastga qarab ketadigan spiraliga kirishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatning tobora yomonlashuvi, nazoratni yo'qotish.
